The '''Arrgaw system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]],<ref name="TEA-OC" /> on the [[Harrin Trade Corridor]], between the [[Lohopa system/Legends|Lohopa system]] and [[Lazerian system/Legends|Lazerian system]].<ref name="TSK" />
